description: The two object-key rules that genuinely diverge, both live-measured: OBJECT_AGG takes a VARIANT key and uses its VALUE text (columns, literals, expressions and CONDITIONAL keys alike - never the quoted JSON rendering - with uncast keys untouched), while OBJECT_CONSTRUCT refuses every non-text key naming its declared type (VARIANT, NUMBER(38,0), BOOLEAN, DATE - in any pair position, with OBJECT_CONSTRUCT_KEEP_NULL reporting under its own name, and a view over the body refused too); text keys and VARIANT VALUES stay fine. Converted 1:1 from expressions/ObjectAggVariantKeyTest + expressions/ObjectConstructKeyTypeTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE kv (k VARCHAR(20), v VARCHAR(20))
INSERT INTO kv SELECT 'WIDGET_ONE', 's-1'
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(k::VARIANT, v::VARIANT) AS c FROM kv
SELECT OBJECT_AGG('lit'::VARIANT, v::VARIANT) AS c FROM kv
SELECT OBJECT_AGG((LOWER(k) || '_x')::VARIANT, v::VARIANT) AS c FROM kv
CREATE TABLE kv (k VARCHAR(20), v VARCHAR(20))
INSERT INTO kv SELECT 'WIDGET_ONE', 's-1'
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(CASE WHEN k = 'X' THEN 'other' ELSE LOWER(k) || '_agent_id' END::VARIANT, v::VARIANT) AS c FROM kv
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(IFF(k = 'X', 'other', LOWER(k) || '_agent_id')::VARIANT, v::VARIANT) AS c FROM kv
CREATE TABLE kv (k VARCHAR(20), v VARCHAR(20))
INSERT INTO kv SELECT 'WIDGET_ONE', 's-1'
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(k, v::VARIANT) AS c FROM kv
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(CASE WHEN k = 'X' THEN 'other' ELSE LOWER(k) || '_agent_id' END, v::VARIANT) AS c FROM kv
CREATE TABLE kv (k VARCHAR(20), v VARCHAR(20), n NUMBER, d DATE, b BOOLEAN, va VARIANT)
INSERT INTO kv SELECT 'WIDGET', 's-1', 7, '2026-01-01', TRUE, TO_VARIANT('x')
SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(va, v) AS c FROM kv

error.messageContains: Function OBJECT_CONSTRUCT does not support VARIANT argument type for keys
